title: Moyva parallel audit event trace record (JSONL)
description: One JSON object per line. The delta/event trace is the audit's proof that committed state actually changed: it records canonical SignalBus events and command results, each pinned to snapshot sequence/frame/time from the run header. A scan MUST NOT fabricate deltas by calling preview APIs (e.g. IConstructionSessionCommands.TryPreviewAt); a trace row is evidence of a real state transition or a real rejected/accepted command.

runId.description: Correlates to the run header, e.g. <taskId>-<seed>-<utcstamp>.

sequence.description: Snapshot sequence from the run header this event belongs to.

frame.description: Time.frameCount when the event was observed.

gameTime.description: Time.time (scaled). Frozen value while game is paused distinguishes pause from capture-tool downtime.

kind.description: signal = SignalBus event observed; command-result = canonical command accepted/rejected; query-snapshot = read-only canonical query sample; marker = harness annotation (e.g. capture-start).

name.description: Signal type name (e.g. UnitMovedSignal, WorldGeneratedDataSignal, GamePausedSignal) or command/query id.

source.description: Emitting authority, e.g. GameStateService, UnitMovementService, ConstructionService, MultiplayerAuthorityService, harness.

payload.description: Serialized public fields of the signal/result (unitId, position, reason, ...).

provenance.description: How the event was produced. bridge-injected/editor-simulated rows are diagnostics only and cannot satisfy gameplay-evidence acceptance.
